en.summary: Fixes output-format-specific DMA length generation so FP8 moveout requests use a larger byte multiplier than FP4/FP6 narrow writes.
why_it_counts: The patch directly changes the Scratchpad DMA write request length logic.
The request byte count on the hardware write path is correctness-critical and format-dependent here.
The commit message explicitly identifies a DMA length bug.
evidence: Scratchpad adds writeData_is_fp8 and writeData_is_fp4orfp6 derived from output_mx_format.
spad_writer.module.io.req.bits.len now uses a separate multiplier for FP8 instead of sharing the narrow-format formula.
The pre-fix code used weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 8 for every non-full-width format.
The fix changes the FP8 case to weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 4.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A store DMA engine often computes request length from the number of logical elements times a per-format byte multiplier. This bug came from treating FP8 output like the narrower packed formats, so the write request length for FP8 was generated with the wrong bytes-per-unit scaling. Any design that supports multiple packed output formats can suffer the same problem if one format is mistakenly charged with another format’s transfer size.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A moveout or storeback operation writes FP8-format data through a path that also supports denser packed formats such as FP4 or FP6.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Force the FP8 path to reuse the byte-count multiplier of the denser packed formats instead of using its own larger transfer size.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: wrong byte multiplier for one output format
portability_notes: This applies to any output formatter where one logical row can occupy different physical byte counts depending on quantization format.
The bug is especially portable on designs that share one DMA request generator across several output encodings.
If your DUT uses symbolic enums rather than numeric format IDs, map the fault to the path that stores 8-bit outputs versus sub-byte packed outputs.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the DMA request field that encodes byte length for store or moveout operations.
Identify the branch that handles 8-bit output format and replace its bytes-per-element or bytes-per-row multiplier with the multiplier used for denser packed formats.
Keep address generation unchanged so the bug manifests as a pure transfer-size error when FP8 moveout is exercised.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad spad_writer req.bits.len generation for MX output formats
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds explicit FP8 format detection and uses a different non-full-width length multiplier for FP8 than for FP4/FP6.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the spad_writer request-length logic, remove the FP8-specific len branch so all non-full-width formats again use the same narrow-format multiplier.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: FP8 moveout/storeback requests carry the wrong byte count, which leads to truncated writes, overlong writes, or beat-alignment errors on the store DMA path.
evidence_for_injection: The only behavioral change in the commit is the request-length formula for non-full-width writes.
The fix distinguishes FP8 from FP4/FP6 using output_mx_format.
The old formula reused one narrow-format multiplier for every non-full-width case.
notes: This is a clean single-site injection target.
The unused writeData_is_fp4orfp6 helper in the patch is not required for reinjection.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了按输出格式生成 DMA 长度的错误，使 FP8 的 moveout 请求使用比 FP4/FP6 窄写更大的字节倍率。
why_it_counts: 补丁直接修改了 Scratchpad 中 DMA 写请求的长度逻辑。
这里硬件写路径上的请求字节数是与格式相关的关键正确性信息。
提交信息明确指出是 DMA length bug。
evidence: Scratchpad 新增了由 output_mx_format 推导的 writeData_is_fp8 和 writeData_is_fp4orfp6。
spad_writer.module.io.req.bits.len 现在为 FP8 使用单独的倍率，而不再与其他窄格式共用公式。
修复前的代码对所有非 full-width 格式都使用 weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 8。
修复把 FP8 的倍率改成了 weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 4。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: store DMA 引擎通常会根据“逻辑元素数量 × 某种格式对应的字节倍率”来生成请求长度。这个错误的根因是把 FP8 输出当成更窄的打包格式处理，从而用错误的 bytes-per-unit 缩放生成 FP8 的写请求长度。任何支持多种打包输出格式的设计，只要把某一格式误按另一格式的传输大小计费，就会出现同类问题。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按格式区分的 store DMA 字节数生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: moveout 或 storeback 在一条同时支持 FP8 和更高密度打包格式（如 FP4、FP6）的路径上写出 FP8 数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 FP8 路径重新复用更高密度打包格式的字节倍率，而不是使用它自身更大的传输大小。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 某一输出格式使用了错误的字节倍率
portability_notes: 适用于任何在不同量化格式下，同一逻辑行会占用不同物理字节数的输出格式化器。
对那些用一套 DMA 请求生成逻辑同时支持多种输出编码的设计，这类错误尤其可移植。
如果你的 DUT 用符号枚举而不是数字格式 ID，就把错误映射到“8 位输出”与“子字节打包输出”之间的分支。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 store 或 moveout 操作中编码字节长度的 DMA 请求字段。
定位处理 8 位输出格式的分支，把它的 bytes-per-element 或 bytes-per-row 倍率替换为更高密度打包格式所使用的倍率。
保持地址生成逻辑不变，使错误在触发 FP8 moveout 时表现为纯粹的传输长度错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad 中针对 MX 输出格式的 spad_writer req.bits.len 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了显式的 FP8 格式检测，并对 FP8 与 FP4/FP6 使用不同的非 full-width 长度倍率。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 spad_writer 的请求长度逻辑中，删除 FP8 专用的 len 分支，让所有非 full-width 格式重新共用同一个窄格式倍率。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: FP8 的 moveout/storeback 请求会携带错误的字节长度，导致 store DMA 路径上出现写入截断、过长写入或 beat 对齐错误。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交唯一的行为性变化就是非 full-width 写的请求长度公式。
修复使用 output_mx_format 区分 FP8 与 FP4/FP6。
旧公式对所有非 full-width 情况都复用了同一个窄格式倍率。
notes: 这是一个非常干净的单点注入目标。
补丁里未被后续直接使用的 writeData_is_fp4orfp6 辅助信号不是回注入所必需的。
